# Vault Syncryption API reference

Every endpoint of the sync API, generated from the server's OpenAPI schema. It is protocol
version `1`. [protocol.md](protocol.md) explains the flows this reference
only lists: the auth handshake, joining, pairing, conflicts, retention, limits and rate
limits, and the admin API. Crypto details are in [crypto.md](crypto.md).

- **Base URL:** the configured endpoint, e.g. `https://notes.example.com`.
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from `POST /api/v1/auth/verify` on every
  endpoint except `GET /health`, `POST /api/v1/auth/challenge` and
  `POST /api/v1/auth/verify`.
- **Bodies:** JSON, except blob uploads and downloads, which are raw bytes.
- **Binary values in JSON** are base64url without padding, and times are RFC 3339 UTC
  strings.
- **Errors:** every error answers with the [Error](#error) body. A body or parameter that
  fails validation gives `bad_request` with `details.fields` (locations and messages only,
  never the input). Each endpoint below lists the statuses the schema states; the full set
  of status and machine codes is in protocol.md 1.
- The admin API (`/admin`), the home page (`/`) and the icons are outside this reference
  and are documented in protocol.md 2 and 14.

## Endpoints

### Server

#### `GET /health`

`200` with `{status, version, protocol, maintenance, adminContact}` once the database and the blob store answer, `503` with `"status": "unavailable"` otherwise. Needs no token, and stays `200` during maintenance, which only pauses `/api/v1`.

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | `any` (`application/json`) |  |

#### `GET /metrics`

Prometheus metrics in the text exposition format. Needs no token, but answers only clients in `METRICS_ALLOWED_IPS` (empty: loopback and private ranges); others get `403 forbidden`. Only counts: requests by route template and status, users, vaults, keys by status, files, revisions, blobs and their bytes, active locks, open long-polls, cleanup runs, wrong shared secrets and admin tokens, and process metrics. No label names a user, vault, device or path. `DISABLE_METRICS=TRUE` removes the endpoint (`404`).

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | `any` (`text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8`) |  |

### Auth

Logging in, and joining the server with a new key.

#### `POST /api/v1/auth/challenge`

Start a login: the message the device signs with its encryption key. It is issued for any well-formed key, username and vault name, is single use and expires after 60 s. The client checks every line of the message before it signs (protocol.md 5.1).

Request body: [ChallengeRequest](#challengerequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ChallengeResponse](#challengeresponse) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `POST /api/v1/auth/verify`

Finish a login with the signature over the challenge, and return a session token. A key the server doesn't know joins here: as a pending device when the vault exists, or with the shared secret as the device that creates it (protocol.md 5.2).

Request body: [VerifyRequest](#verifyrequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [VerifyResponse](#verifyresponse) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

### Vaults

Opening or creating a vault, its keyring and recovery.

#### `POST /api/v1/vaults/open`

The caller's vault. 404 while the device still has to create it. For a pending device only the vault's id and name are real: `keyringVersion` and `seq` are 0 and `createdAt` is the Unix epoch until it is approved.

Request body: [OpenRequest](#openrequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [OpenResponse](#openresponse) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `POST /api/v1/vaults`

Create the vault the calling key registered with, together with its first keyring. The client picks the vault id, so it can build that keyring before the request.

Request body: [CreateRequest](#createrequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [Vault](#vault) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `GET /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/blobs/{blob_id}`

#### `HEAD /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/blobs/{blob_id}`

Whether the blob is stored: `200` with its `Content-Length`, or `404` with no body.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `blob_id` | `string` |  |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | raw bytes (`application/octet-stream`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `PUT /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/blobs/{blob_id}`

Upload one encrypted chunk as raw bytes. The server hashes the body and refuses it with `422 hash_mismatch` unless the hash equals `blob_id`. A new blob is refused with `507 storage_full` when the server's data volume is nearly full, and with `507 quota_exceeded` when it would take the vault's stored blobs past the quota the administrator set (protocol.md 12).

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `blob_id` | `string` |  |

Request body: raw bytes (`application/octet-stream`)

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [BlobInfo](#blobinfo) (`application/json`) | The blob was already stored. |
| `201` | [BlobInfo](#blobinfo) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `POST /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/blobs/missing`

### Sync

Committing revisions, history, the change feed and the long-poll.

#### `GET /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/files/{file_id}`

The file's current revision, deletions (tombstones) included.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `file_id` | `string` |  |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [Revision](#revision) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `PUT /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/files/{file_id}`

Commit a new revision of one file. `parentRev` must be the current head, or `null` for a file that must not exist yet; otherwise the answer is `409 stale_parent` with the head, so the client can merge without another round trip. Every blob must be uploaded first. While the server's data volume is nearly full, commits other than deletions are refused with `507 storage_full` (protocol.md 12).

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `file_id` | `string` |  |

Request body: [CommitRequest](#commitrequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | [Revision](#revision) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `GET /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/files/{file_id}/revs`

One page of the file's revisions, newest first. To page back, pass the last `rev` as `before`. What the server keeps is fixed by retention (protocol.md 9.3).

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `file_id` | `string` |  |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | `integer` \| `null` | no |  |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Default `50`, 1 to 100. |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [History](#history) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `GET /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/files/{file_id}/revs/{rev}`

One revision of the file, used as a merge base and to restore an old version. A revision retention removed, or one of another file, is `404 not_found`.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `file_id` | `string` |  |
| `rev` | `integer` |  |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [Revision](#revision) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `GET /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/changes`

The vault's change feed: every revision with `rev > since`, oldest first, with its `meta`, so a client applies a batch without one request per file. It stores `cursor` once the batch is applied.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | `integer` | no | Default `0`, at least 0. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Default `500`, 1 to 1000. |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [Changes](#changes) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `GET /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/wait`

Long-poll for live updates: answers as soon as the vault's `seq`, `locksSeq` or keyring version has passed what the client knows, or after `timeout` seconds with `changed: false`. The client then calls `/changes` or `/locks` and waits again.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | `integer` | no | Default `0`, at least 0. |
| `locksSince` | `integer` | no | Default `0`, at least 0. |
| `keyringSince` | `integer` \| `null` | no |  |
| `timeout` | `number` | no | Default `25`, 0 to 25. |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [WaitResponse](#waitresponse) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

### Locks

Soft lease locks on the file someone is editing.

#### `GET /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/locks`

The vault's live locks, by `fileId`. Expired ones are swept first, so they never appear.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [Locks](#locks) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `POST /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/locks/{file_id}`

Take the file's lease lock, or renew one the caller already holds. Another holder gives `423 locked` with the lock, which only warns: locks never block a commit.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `file_id` | `string` |  |

Request body: [AcquireRequest](#acquirerequest) (`application/json`)

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [Lock](#lock) (`application/json`) |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

#### `DELETE /api/v1/vaults/{vault_id}/locks/{file_id}`

Release the lock. Idempotent, and only its holder `(device, clientId)` can do it.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_id` | `string` |  |
| `file_id` | `string` |  |

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | `string` | yes |  |

| Status | Body | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | no body |  |
| `400` | [Error](#error) (`application/json`) | A body or parameter that fails validation: `bad_request`. |

### VerifyRequest

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

| `sharedSecret` | `string` \| `null` | no | Needed only by a new key whose vault doesn't exist yet (protocol.md 5.2). |
